goal: Raise Jev checkpoint confidence by giving each low-confidence checkpoint facts that separate its choices, and stop the workbench chart pooling unlabeled legacy advice with harness checkpoints.
constraints: Prompt text, reply text, paths and source never leave the machine; only locally derived counts and fixed labels are sent.
The handoff check stays shadow-only and a Stop hook never fails.

non_goals.description: Do not change Jev provider calls, decision receipts or the threshold.
Do not rewrite historical audit events or advice records.

acceptance.criterion: Prompt and handoff checkpoints send the new derived facts and no private text
Session-start metadata no longer claims scope_unclear
The daily confidence chart excludes legacy_advice rows
